48.original: A welcome sight in my hour of need.

49.original: As you know, a number of our stone sentinels have turned against us. But if they can be slain, they may yet serve to protect these ruins.

50.original: We lack the knowledge to build more, but it is possible to use their parts to repair those that yet remain.

51.original: If you could slay even a single sentinel and bring me its core, that is all I require to begin my work.

52.original: I only require a single core to begin my work.

55.original: As I said before, we lack the knowledge to build the sentinels. And this is perhaps the most difficult piece to replicate.

56.original: So long as their cores can be retrieved, we can prolong the life of those we yet have.
